path.description: The absolute path of the local video file to file; it is copied into the theater.

titleId.description: The title to file it under.

title.description: The name of the title to file it under, where no titleId is given: an existing title of the realm by that exact name, else a new clip title.

realm.description: The realm a new title stands in; mine where none.

name.description: The episode's name; the file's name where none.

label.description: A short label for the episode.

share.description: Also open a share link to it and answer its address, for a room.
